propositions: Add a packaged eval spec for T15 plan-review criterion with positive deployed-service cases covering boot, authentication, authorization, connectivity, and readiness risks plus negative cases for destructive cleanup and boundary conditions.

Dataset must include applicable/pass case with concrete out-of-loop proof and experiment-scoped cleanup, applicable/finding cases for slow delivery loop feedback and pre-existing table/shared bucket destruction, and not-applicable/pass cases for app-only, library-only, CLI-only, docs-only, health-route, and S2/S3 boundary plans.
Extend existing unit tests to validate packaged spec schema, registered deterministic scorers, balanced dataset, gold-set coverage, and T15 case identifiers through the public eval loader.
Record application-scope false positives in observed-false-positives.md as regression guards.
